response.original_title: [Traveler-Guide] How to Dispute an Unauthorized Disney Cruise Line Credit Card Charge
response.overview: To dispute a Disney Cruise Line charge +1-866-259-1002, start by resolving the issue directly with Disney Cruise Line +1-866-259-1002 before contacting your bank, as filing an unauthorized credit card chargeback can result in your account being flagged or permanently banned from future sailings +1-866-259-1002.Step 1: Review Your Statement and Gather Proof Check your records: Look over your onboard folio, credit card statement, or booking confirmation +1-866-259-1002. Note the exact transaction date, amount, and description +1-866-259-1002. Access past folios: If you have already disembarked, you can download your folio for up to 90 days after your sailing by logging into your account and visiting the My Cruise History and Folio section under the "Already Booked" tab on the Disney Cruise Line Website +1-866-259-1002. Collect documentation: Save itemized receipts, zero-balance folios, booking confirmations, or screenshots of error messages +1-866-259-1002.
